latestVersion.changelog:
franchise-evaluation-coach v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Guides prospects through end-to-end franchise evaluation, focusing on critical due diligence steps.
- Explains how to read all 23 FDD Items with an emphasis on red flags and deal-breaking clauses.
- Provides best practices for validating Item 19 financial disclosures against real franchisee data.
- Outlines methods for conducting effective current and ex-franchisee calls.
- Helps compare franchise investment/ROI with starting an independent business in the same sector.
- Surfaces common traps in fee structures, territory terms, renewals, transfers, and terminations.
